value.behaviour: Adds the page keys to AppState, a page id to collaborators and search matches, and `setActivePage` to the imperative API.
rules: `ExcalidrawPage` and `PageViewport` are added to the existing `@excalidraw/element/types` type import list.

AppState gains, after `fontTopPicks`: `pages: readonly ExcalidrawPage[]` (doc: ordered by index, deleted pages kept as tombstones), `activePageId: ExcalidrawPage["id"]` and `pageViewports: Readonly<Record<ExcalidrawPage["id"], PageViewport>>` (doc: saved viewports of the pages that are not active).
`Collaborator` gains `pageId?: string` (doc: the page the collaborator is on; pointers render only for the local active page).
`SearchMatch` gains `pageId: string` (doc: the page holding the matched element).

`ExcalidrawImperativeAPI` gains `setActivePage: InstanceType<typeof App>["setActivePage"];` with a doc comment saying it switches to a visible page and restores its viewport, and does nothing for an unknown id.
SceneData is unchanged: pages arrive through `appState`.

sites.rule: Add `ExcalidrawPage,` and `PageViewport,` to the import list.
Add the documented `pageId?: string;` field to Collaborator.
Add the three documented page keys to AppState.

value.behaviour: Gives the page keys a one-page default and registers their storage flags.
rules: `getDefaultAppState` returns `pages: [getDefaultPage()]`, `activePageId: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID` and `pageViewports: {}`; `getDefaultPage` and `DEFAULT_PAGE_ID` are imported from `@excalidraw/element` in a new import statement placed after the `@excalidraw/common` import.

`APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF` gains `pages: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }`, `activePageId: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }`, `pageViewports: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }`.

sites.rule: Add a blank line and `import { DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, getDefaultPage } from "@excalidraw/element";`.

sites.first_line: fontTopPicks: { browser: true, export: false, server: false },
